_about: How the assistant asks for each detail. Key: <Category_ID>.<Field_Name>. 'ask' is the question; 'options' become buttons (the dataset's own dropdown options are used when there are none here). 'type_own' adds a 'Something else, I'll type it' button. 'from_profile' fills the field from the signed-in employee's profile instead of asking.

CAT-01.last_successful_login.ask: When did you last sign in successfully?

CAT-01.mfa_still_working.ask: Does your authenticator app (MFA) still work on your phone?

CAT-02.error_message.ask: What happens when the VPN fails to connect?
options: It times out or keeps trying

CAT-02.os_version.ask: Which operating system is your laptop on?

CAT-02.vpn_client_version.ask: Do you know the VPN app's version? You'll find it under Help → About.

CAT-02.last_successful_connect.ask: When did the VPN last work for you?

CAT-03.software_name.ask: Which software do you need? Please give the exact name, for example Adobe Photoshop or Tableau.

CAT-03.business_justification.ask: In a sentence, what do you need it for? Your manager sees this when approving.

CAT-03.preferred_version.ask: Do you need a particular version?

CAT-04.asset_tag.ask: What's the asset tag on the device? It's on a sticker, for example LT-12345.

CAT-04.location.ask: Where is the device right now? Floor and desk, or city if you're remote.

CAT-05.device_change.ask: Have you changed or reset your phone recently?

CAT-05.backup_codes_available.ask: Do you still have your backup codes?

CAT-06.client.ask: Which email app are you using?

options: Sent, but people don't receive it
Outlook won't open or keeps crashing

CAT-06.mailbox_size_known.ask: Have you seen a 'mailbox almost full' warning?

CAT-07.application_name.ask: Which application do you need access to? For example Salesforce, Jira or Confluence.

CAT-07.requested_role.ask: What level of access do you need?

CAT-07.manager_approval.ask: Has your manager already approved this?

CAT-08.others_affected.ask: Is anyone else around you having the same problem?

CAT-09.incident_type.ask: What kind of security concern is it?

CAT-09.email_headers_or_screenshot.ask: If you can, attach a screenshot of the message with the + button. Otherwise, choose Skip.

CAT-09.actions_already_taken.ask: Have you done anything with it so far?

CAT-10.printer_name_or_id.ask: Which printer is it? The name is on its label, for example Floor3-HP-01.

CAT-10.error_code.ask: What does the printer or your screen show?

CAT-12.device_os.ask: Is your phone an iPhone or Android?

CAT-12.issue_type.ask: What do you need help with?
